## Checklist

<!-- Tick before requesting review. -->

      branch conventions.
- [ ] My commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally.
- [ ] `pnpm build` produces a clean `dist/`.
- [ ] I added / updated tests where it makes sense (validation, grading,

- [ ] I added / updated docs (README, CHANGELOG, lesson frontmatter) for any
      user-visible change.
- [ ] No new warnings in the console or terminal output.
- [ ] No breaking changes to public routes, JSON shapes, or localStorage keys
      (or called out explicitly above with a migration note).
- [ ] I did **not** add any backend call, telemetry, analytics, or account
      system. The app is 100% local and stays that way.
